crossRefs.note: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom Yahweh said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according…
“You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,
Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on Yahweh, and he…
He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us…
By a prophet Yahweh brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel said to the people, “It is Yahweh who appointed Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
translations.bsb: Then Samuel said to the people, “The LORD is the One who appointed Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: And Samuel said unto the people, It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought ➔ your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
translations.asv: And Samuel said unto the people, It is Jehovah that appointed Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
